notes.title: Next update!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! I know I've been away, I've been busy with a lot of things, but one of them has been the Dungeons update for SurvivalWorld. In my opinion, the update looks great, bringing a lot of content![/p][p][/p][p]Among many things, we'll have an introduction to the game's story. In addition to the existing one, you'll now be able to find recipes in ruins and other places, which you'll need to learn to unlock new items! In addition to adding colored wood, for now it'll only be red, blue, and green, but I'll be introducing more colored blocks later.[/p][p][/p][p]Some images[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/736001f4dab11e152f3ef00ed0af83ee7a937043.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/e486891e457c05fe43244bdc049d58452b50083d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/3a2ce0a20dfa8b1d562020e255a1018c92252e56.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/5ff1ee3c51b7a9b3e451acc64527bc10292a2ff8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/6f0421c6dcfc901097f3ffcc42c600a66931928d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.3.1
notes.content:
Hello! Today I'm bringing you update 0.3.1.

A small update that brings some new features and mostly bug fixes.

[h1]Animal Breeders:
[/h1]
Starting with this update, a feeder will be included, where we can put food for our animals and they'll automatically eat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/b12b2c521cced6ecd580faf7bfd77f95d2e20e18.png[/img]

The animal inventory menu has also been slightly changed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/9aeab054755a8f0f09fc5c57ff2042688604353f.png[/img]

The thirst statistic for domesticated animals has been removed, as it could complicate things, requiring you to keep track of it. Therefore, you should only ensure that the animal is fed.

To mate with another animal, both must be domesticated, have their favorite food in the feeder, and have the mating option enabled. The baby will be born in a matter of seconds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/0df636cc49395fa41ed3d72bccfdeab9ea124693.png[/img]

Babies can also appear naturally. These will take a real-world hour to grow, and the parents will have a cooldown of a few minutes to have another hatchling.

[h1]Regarding bugs and minor changes:[/h1]

-The player is now larger.

-The torch lighting has been slightly changed to avoid visual glitches.

-Days and nights are longer.

-Creatures in caves now take longer to spawn.

notes.title: New Update: 0.3.0
notes.content:
Hello! It's been a while since the last update. I've been a bit busy with other aspects of my life, which is why I'm bringing this update.

This update is focused on Magic, bringing new mechanics, features, blocks, and more, which I'll show you below.

Note: I've postponed the Hydra boss until the next update, as it's a boss I want to dedicate development time to, so that the fight against it is a true experience. If I submitted it now, it would have been just another boss in the game, which I don't want to be. Therefore, it will be for update 0.3.1.

[h1]News![/h1]

Starting with the main course, MAGIC. Magic is an attribute we can unlock once we defeat the Skeleton Boss and craft the Magic Amulet.

This must be equipped in the new accessories section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/972a13adb4323884711392214abc4b888a92fd0a.png[/img]

We won't lose it upon death.

How it works is that once the Magic Amulet is equipped, killing creatures will give us Mana. This Mana will be represented in a bar on the side of the HUD. Mana will also be used to learn spells and level them up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/7fd901ef9a18c3db85e85e7bfb3122a6c5fc65ed.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/c26c5cb8c4bc35ec7c7cbe917133de8b2af77958.png[/img]

To be able to use spells, we must learn and craft the Magic Cauldron to create the Magic Wand, which will allow us to cast spells at a specific Mana cost.

Currently, we have 6 spells:

[olist]
[*] Magic Sphere Throw
[*] Throw enemies into the air
[*] Mana Magnetism (Will draw mana towards us)
[*] Magic Charged Beam and Healing Magic Charged Beam
[*] The latter will do damage like the former, except it will drain the life out of enemies.
[*] Double Jump
[/olist]

Once you kill the skeleton boss, a group of beings, part of a kind of magic-related society, will begin to watch you. Some will flee when you approach, while others will attack you with magical attacks.
Wizards:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/00f839fa45d7a3e5ee2ecfbea5dd00f2b8e08e17.png[/img]

In the Cauldron, we can craft Mana Essence: This will replenish our mana in exchange for health.
Golem Stones: When placed, these will be destroyed, generating a golem that we can have as an adventure companion, or simply wander around the area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/823a41ae5dc8559ecd345b6a9c2f5be83f6e3dc8.png[/img]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]

The world creation menu now has a Rules section, where you can select whether you want animals to appear, trees, rocks, or bushes to be generated (the latter only applies to flat worlds), cheats, or a day/night cycle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/48e48b11e79845f81e70840414a9b0909f386407.png[/img]

The inventory now features a more separate and simpler layout. Slots now only display durability and water bars, leaving a cleaner view.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/0e93ffb690835383168a43597c332b1cc2c390ed.png[/img]

Hotbar:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/b6b56a93951d9da42a83cc3758dbf0a7c2a5457f.png[/img]

[h2]New set of Metal Brick Blocks:
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/745b10ba26ca61bfcea3cd1a1fb3f1a081da873b.png[/img]

[h1]Dynamite[/h1]
This set comes with a new resource: Gunpowder, which is obtained by using charcoal in a mortar. Dynamite can destroy nearby trees, including built structures, so be careful. It can also be used as a method to kill creatures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/f069eb77d8583aedac4438170eb7d20d4c74adf9.png[/img]

New items in general:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/ec9bf517b6953ba600b1afc3ea36fff699190893.png[/img]

A little improvement about the design in Blueprints section:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/3c7311f99130fa0bc2a92bc6cca11a660bdcde36.png[/img]

Crafting panel in Workbenchs now is a bit smaller:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/2f6e2764957c12207fa9741f8448106daa57a0e0.png[/img]

Fixed various bugs related to visuals, performance, a lighting issue with the character in the inventory, and more.

That's all for this update! Thanks so much for the support.

notes.title: Update 0.2.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today I share with you the changes of this new update 0.2.3

[h1]Skeleton King[/h1]

The Skeleton King underwent a huge change, both in the arena, as well as in the model, animations and attacks. Now in the distance he will launch spheres of magic, up close he will attack us with his sword, and if we get too close he will kick us. In addition to that it will also generate skeletons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/6846ebc3e8e46be8127b01c052ab5d1e06ab9f8f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/7b88c011ff76340a0db3cba79d3631a21f730594.png[/img]

Upon defeating him we will see a new death animation. When he dies he will give us the magic skeleton key. And in turn he will grant us the "MAGIC AMULET" 

Currently it does not have any function, but soon it will have certain interesting things, like obviously, doing magic...

[h1]Visuals and Optimization [/h1]

I was in charge of correcting and changing the code properly, optimizing and changing certain things that made the performance of the game improve considerably, which meant improving the visual quality of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/c2a3dc2b0dedb0728f3d4a3a03329c394f62bb3b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/61855449f5108359984e8c4f65d1376b89799e7e.png[/img]

[h1]Creatures and modifications in the World[/h1]

Penguins were added, located in snowy areas, they can be tamed with Cyan Fish.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/e984af0e25b532abd3ec4e37f51a1ca705bb7be3.png[/img]

Minotaurs are aggressive creatures that can kill you very easily, located in the Blood Lands.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/1f81deb5175f2b5791bb3a8ff8daf4548b20baa0.png[/img]

Since it had a somewhat ugly appearance, I decided to cover the volcano, now once again being a normal mountain (Maybe in the future we will see a better designed volcano).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/1bfbb09334f439e72f6e412f03615c07b1eaa878.png[/img]

notes.title: New Update: 0.1.1
notes.content:
Hello! This new update contains many important technical fixes and new features. Let's get started!

[h1]Tools and weapons[/h1]

The tools, the whole system in general was reprogrammed and is now more polished, new animations, I modified the First Person mode now the character's arms will be anchored to the camera, so we can see where we hit, or where we aim, or simply the tools and weapons will follow our gaze.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/7e7eae3e3044c622813d7795d7ef172f9bbc3e12.png[/img]

Continuing along the same lines, we can now attack with tools such as axes and picks, the torch has undergone some small changes. The interaction with any equipped weapon or tool is now permanent, previously when changing a tool slot, it was unequipped, or when we refilled the canteen the same thing happened, now it remains permanently without having to be constantly equipping it.


The liquid collector has undergone both visual and technical modifications, now we can collect liquids such as oil (obtained from the caves) and Lava, the latter we can use to burn creatures and different things (Next update will contain fire issues)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/6f3278ec4a3bda2725339050b0dc414150bcd8ec.png[/img]

[h1]Magic invocations:[/h1]

What is this? In the caves, not all of them, we can find a pedestal with which we can interact, this will ask us for certain materials such as crystals or precious metals, when activating it a system of up to 6 waves with up to 35 enemies will be activated. These can vary depending on the cave...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/834e9fb872e106c1deba10cf6d1f1a2a53b4c638.png[/img]

Peaceful creatures are corrupted by the summoner at the time of being generated, therefore they will be aggressive, when completing the invocation we will receive rewards, and here we present the gems of the invocation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/2a6d3167247f4b797fb34c3d35cff13586bb1210.png[/img]

[h1]Summoning Gems and Skeleton Guardian[/h1]

The summoning gems will help us interact with other summoning points, or use them in the structure located near the center of the world, where having all the requirements will take us to the cave of the Skeleton Guardian, the first boss of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/ed9bc2ff6b3620fad3af24688e4a20dc7f4d7dfe.png[/img]

The Guardian will have 9000 health, if we go without armor with a simple blow he will finish us off, with a simple attack with his Tasmite sword or magically summoning a number of skeletons that will attack us.

Once defeated he will give us the Skeleton Key, which in a future update will be useful for opening new worlds.

On the other hand, the world expansion went to the snow side, adding a new Tundra zone, also visually the biomes changed some colors, due to failures the volumetric fog was removed. In addition to that new performance optimizations were implemented.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45216863/4553a3a61b9b3985888bcaf9190b03ac815a8856.png[/img]

Thank you very much for your attention
